Command: Stretch Out Your Hand Over the Sea
Summary: God's command at the Red Sea: speak that Israel go forward, lift the rod, and stretch out the hand over the sea to divide it.
Commandment: Lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it, that the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
Application: Two utterances, one event: lift the rod and stretch out the hand (Exodus 14:16), then stretch it out again to close the sea (14:26). Moses is also told to speak to Israel that they go forward (14:15) — covered here as part of the same crossing command, not a separate row.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
Purpose: To divide the sea for Israel's escape and to close it on Pharaoh's army, showing that the LORD fought for Israel (Exodus 14:25, 14:30-31).
